messages.author: 82b3a873d546b75a
messages.subject: Position of xlabel
parts:
Hi,

When I plot my graphs, xlabel is too close to the breaks labels, as shown at:
<https://skitch.com/nikkne/rh6w9/find-tet.pdf-1-page>

I plot using this code:

ggplot(data=data) +
geom_point(aes(x=texec,y=throughput,shape=proto), size=1.5) +
geom_line(size=0.4, aes(x=texec,y=throughput,linetype=proto)) +
facet_grid(type~platform, labeller=label.cluster) +
geom_vline(aes(xintercept=vl), data=TET)

breaks <- 10**(1:10)
last_plot() + scale_y_log10("throughput [req/s]", breaks=breaks, limits=c(3500,160000)) +
scale_x_continuous(expression(paste("application execution time [",mu,"s]")), limits=c(0,125)) +
labs(linetype="Protocol",shape="Protocol")
last_plot() + theme_bw()


last_plot() + opts(legend.position=c(0.45,0.79), legend.background = theme_rect(col = 0), legend.ncol=2, xlabel=theme_text(vjust=1, lineheight=2), axis.text.x=theme_text(vjust=0))

These opts are my attempt to move the xlabel a bit down, but I'm failing. Any good trick to separate xaxis text and the xlabel?

Thanks,
Nikola

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: Position of xlabel
parts:
Hi:

The problem with that suggestion is that the OP wants to use an
expression for the x label and \n doesn't work in expressions. The \n
trick on y should work as long as the font size isn't altered, but try
this for the expression (borrowed from memory by a trick I saw on
R-help for this kind of thing):

scale_x_continuous(expression(atop(phantom(0),
paste("application execution time[",mu,"s]"))),
limits=c(0,125))

atop basically creates the space for a fraction without the line.
phantom(0) creates space for the 0 character but doesn't print it. A
little bit more than a line of space is added, but it does give
separation :)

Someone gave a better, more robust solution for the spacing problem in
this forum a month or two ago that adjusts for changes in font size,
etc., but I can't find it in the archives at the moment.

HTH,
Dennis

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Position of xlabel
parts:
I have this in my .Rprofile, until the next ggplot2 update (I think it
was Koshke who posted it),

require(ggplot2)

guide_axis <- function(at, labels, position="right", theme) {
position <- match.arg(position, c("top", "bottom", "right", "left"))
at <- unit(at, "native")
length <- theme$axis.ticks.length
label_pos <- length + theme$axis.ticks.margin
one <- unit(1, "npc")
label_render <- switch(position,
top = , bottom = "axis.text.x",
left = , right = "axis.text.y"
)
label_x <- switch(position,
top = ,
bottom = at,
right = label_pos,
left = one - label_pos
)
label_y <- switch(position,
top = label_pos,
bottom = one - label_pos,
right = ,
left = at,
)
if (is.list(labels)) {
if (any(sapply(labels, is.language))) {
labels <- do.call(expression, labels)
} else {
labels <- unlist(labels)
}
}
labels <- theme_render(theme, label_render, labels, label_x, label_y)
line <- switch(position,
top = theme_render(theme, "axis.line", 0, 0, 1, 0),
bottom = theme_render(theme, "axis.line", 0, 1, 1, 1),
right = theme_render(theme, "axis.line", 0, 1, 0, 1),
left = theme_render(theme, "axis.line", 1, 0, 1, 1)
)
ticks <- switch(position,
top = theme_render(theme, "axis.ticks", at, 0, at, length),
bottom = theme_render(theme, "axis.ticks", at, one - length, at, 1),
right = theme_render(theme, "axis.ticks", 0, at, length, at),
left = theme_render(theme, "axis.ticks", one - length, at, 1, at)
)
absoluteGrob(
gList(ticks, labels, line),
width = grobWidth(labels) + label_pos,
height = grobHeight(labels) + label_pos
)
}

utils::assignInNamespace("guide_axis",guide_axis, "ggplot2")
